about: An AFK human: stands where the party was staged (the UK entrance, areatrigger 4745 target) and idles for the whole run, so the tank walks away from it. Until lb-20261003-155828-1 the puppet started at the camp and walked 27yd back, but the DK tank had already engaged the 34yd Ironhelm pair at 1.05s, before the human was out of spread.
